text:
The block constraints fix the relative order first. Gus is immediately after Cara, and Finn cannot sit two before Gus: that would put Finn immediately before Cara, violating the Cara–Finn separation. So the only legal pattern is Cara, Gus, one slot, Finn.

Ann, Hana, and Ivo all have to precede Cara, and Ann and Ivo have exactly one slot between them, so Cara cannot be earlier than 4. Cara in 4 forces Elif and Ben into adjacent late slots and fails the Ben–Elif separation. Cara in 6 leaves Elif only one legal slot, two after Cara, which is too close. Cara in 5 is the only survivor: Gus is 6, Finn is 8, and Elif must be 9 with Dev exactly two earlier in 7.

Ann and Ivo then occupy 1 and 3. Ann before Hana, and Ann at least three from Ben, put Ann in 1, Hana in 2, Ivo in 3, and Ben in 4. Every listed constraint holds, and every other placement breaks at least one.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Ann","2":"Hana","3":"Ivo","4":"Ben","5":"Cara","6":"Gus","7":"Dev","8":"Finn","9":"Elif"}
CONFIDENCE: 98
